name: redman
description: RedMan — Homelab management tool for backups, sync and containers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.reseed:
npm run seed && echo '
Re-seeded. Restart the server to pick up changes.'
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:8090,5173,5174,5175 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo 'Servers stopped.' || echo 'No servers running.'
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run dev
scripts.clean: rm -f backend/data/*.db backend/data/*.db-wal backend/data/*.db-shm && echo 'Database removed.'
scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm run seed && echo 'Fresh database ready.'
